note: every value here is the tensor the runtime loads; generated by build/construct_weights.py

W_byte_class.equation: row b = onehot(class(b)); C = X @ W_byte_class

W_alpha.equation: row b = onehot(code(b)) over 64-symbol alphabet; A = X @ W_alpha

W_kw_code.equation: kw[k,p,:] = onehot(char p of keyword k); score[t,k] = AND_p (spell[t,p] . kw[k,p]) and length match

v_kw_len.equation: len(kw[k]); used only through the occupancy term

W_lex.equation: W_lex[t, s*NC+c] = +2 if lex_next(s,c)=t else -2; s' = argmax(W_lex @ (s (x) c))

v_cls_punct.equation: 1 for every byte class that forms a one-byte token

W_tokF.equation: byte class -> token class contribution (26x13 selector)

W_gsm.equation: W_gsm[t, s*NF+c] = +2 if grammar_next(s,c)=t else -2; s' = argmax(W_gsm @ (s (x) c))

v_out_barrier.equation: 1 at every statement barrier (SEMI, braces, COMMA)

GT.equation: GT[i,j] = 1 iff i > j; positional greater-than relation
